Cute, stylish, self-assured young adult professional, subtle closed-mouth smile, lively intelligent eyes, calm confident attitude; not a baby, not generic photoreal woman, not 2D anime sticker. Comfortable full-body three-quarter standing pose with head turned toward camera, one arm holds a slim ivory folder against chest, other hand naturally carries the handbag beside thigh, feet planted naturally, no exaggerated twisted limbs. Full hair, hands, bag, feet entirely in frame with comfortable margins. A polished collectible mascot for a marketing strategist's professional portfolio. Genuinely transparent alpha background, NO typography, NO branding/logos, NO poster layout, NO white sticker outline, NO floor or set, NO other figures, NO background haze or glow. Single beautiful solid-volume sculpted figurine, studio-quality shading and crisp miniature material detail.
